tools.name: NFRA Compliance Tools
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: A complete suite of tools for auditors to comply with NFRA rules: Audit Strategy Memorandum (locally hosted and free), Audit Documentation on cloud (paid).

tools.name: GSTR-2B Reconciliation Tool
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: Match your Tally or Easy purchase register against the GST portal's GSTR-2B statement and get a color-coded ITC reconciliation report. Runs entirely in your browser — files never leave your device.

tools.name: e-Signer
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: Draft resolutions and letters on your letterhead, place signatures and stamps anywhere on the page, and export to PDF. Multi-page documents are saved right in your browser — nothing leaves your device.

tools.name: Computation of Income
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: Upload an ITR JSON (ITR-1 to ITR-6) and get a ready-to-print Computation of Income with all schedules, P&L, Balance Sheet and taxes paid — generated entirely in your browser.

tools.name: UDIN Register
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: Firm-level UDIN master register with partner-wise views, automated exception checks (format, membership match, late generation, maker-checker) and monthly portal reconciliation. Data stays in your browser.

tools.name: Litigation Tracker
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: Track Income Tax and GST cases across all forums — notices, replies, hearings and deadlines on one dashboard with overdue alerts. Data stays in your browser.

tools.name: Payroll Tool
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: Run monthly or annual payroll with automatic PF, ESIC and Professional Tax, generate printable payslips and manage multiple organizations. PIN-protected and fully offline.

tools.name: Bank Reconciliation
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: Automatically match bank statements against your ledger with confidence-scored matching, visual analytics and one-click Excel/CSV export.

tools.name: Fixed Asset Manager
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: Maintain a fixed asset register with Companies Act and Income Tax depreciation, Form 3CD Clause 18 blocks, Schedule III notes and DTA/DTL workings.

tools.name: GSTR-1 ↔ Tally Recon
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: Reconcile your GSTR-1 (JSON, Excel or CSV) against your Tally sales register invoice-by-invoice and spot value mismatches instantly.

tools.name: TDS Extractor
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: Extract every transaction, challan and deductee detail from Form 26Q / 24Q FVU (.txt) and TRACES (.pdf) files into a clean, filterable Excel workbook.

tools.name: GST PDF to Excel
tools.creator: Heuristic Techsol LLP
tools.description: Drop in a year of monthly GSTR-1 or GSTR-3B PDFs from the portal and get one clean Excel summary with month-wise figures and year totals.
